title: add-rag-agent-templates-and-tool-calling-examples-docs-update
author: Ava Chen
description: This PR adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) templates, updated agent/tool-calling examples, and corresponding docs site updates to make it easier for developers to bootstrap RAG agents with Redwood. Motivation: reduce time-to-first-success for teams building tool-calling agents that rely on external knowledge sources. Changes are scoped to examples and docs only (no runtime changes). Checklist: - [x] Add canonical RAG templates for FAQ, summarization, and multi-step agents - [x] Add TS/Python quickstarts showcasing tool-calling patterns and agent orchestration - [x] Update docs site navigation and code samples (mkdocs) - [x] Add example unit tests and local dev instructions - [x] Verify doc build and examples CI on main. Related: builds on earlier work in pr-66321 and pr-66666 which introduced the initial agent SDK surface. Linear: ENG-1204 for templates, DOCS-78 for site updates. Notes: integration tests were flaky on the first run due to a transient network dependency in the demo connector; I added a retry wrapper in examples/fixtures to make local dev reliable. No production runtime behavior changed.
